messages.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

The passages do not give a formal textbook definition of an eye diagram, but they treat it as a high-speed PCB/SerDes signal-integrity view of receiver signal quality, used with IL and crosstalk in the SI flow and evaluated through eye opening, eye height, and eye width.[5][11]  
A differential eye diagram can be degraded when differential-pair traces see different fiberglass/epoxy proportions, causing intra-pair skew.[10]
| Product family / solution area | Measurement decision that depends on eye-diagram understanding | Supported measurement choices | Evidence / caveat |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S PCB test solutions for PCB fabricator / system house | Decide whether eye diagram is part of material / stackup selection. | Material / stackup selection includes IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram.[1][2] | The source lists the flow and items, but does not provide stackup rules, material models, or pass/fail criteria.[2] |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow | Decide how to relate eye diagram to IL, crosstalk, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator. | The SI flow lists “IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram,” “TDR Impedance,” “Stackup Planner,” and “TL Calculator.”[5][6] | The source does not identify a specific tool, supplier, or standard for these SI-flow items.[7][8] |
| R&S ZNA vector network analyzer family | Decide whether the ZNA needs extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram. | R&S ZNA is a VNA series covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67, with frequency range from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz.[14] | R&S ZNA-K20 is “Extended time domain analysis including eye diagram” and requires R&S ZNA-K2 “Time domain analysis (TDR).”[15] |
| R&S ZNA / ZNB in AI server PCB solution mapping | Decide between IL/TDR-oriented VNA measurements and eye-diagram-capable ZNA time-domain optioning. | The AI server ecosystem mapping links R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB to IL / TDR.[28] | The passages do not state that R&S ZNB has an eye-diagram option, so that link is not verified. |
| R&S ZNA67 in digital design test success stories | Treat ZNA67 as a referenced product in SOC testing and ATE PCB testing contexts, but not as proof of eye-diagram use. | The success-story mapping lists R&S ZNA67 for SOC testing and ATE PCB testing.[23][24] | The mapping does not provide DUT, interface, frequency, measurement result, or option configuration.[23] |
【推論】If the measurement goal includes eye diagram on R&S ZNA, the supported option path is ZNA-K2 for TDR plus ZNA-K20 for extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram.[15]  
【推論】If the goal is only IL/TDR in PCB or AI-server PCB mapping, the cited passages support R&S ZNA / ZNB as IL/TDR families but do not establish an eye-diagram requirement for ZNB.[28]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

The passages do not give a formal textbook definition of an eye diagram, but they treat it as a high-speed PCB/SerDes signal-integrity view of receiver signal quality, used with IL and crosstalk in the SI flow and evaluated through eye opening, eye height, and eye width.[5][11]  
A differential eye diagram can be degraded when differential-pair traces see different fiberglass/epoxy proportions, causing intra-pair skew.[10]

| R&S ZNA / ZNB in AI server PCB solution mapping | Decide between IL/TDR-oriented VNA measurements and eye-diagram-capable ZNA time-domain optioning. | The AI server ecosystem mapping links R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB to IL / TDR.[28] | The passages do not state that R&S ZNB has an eye-diagram option, so that link is not verified. |

【推論】If the measurement goal includes eye diagram on R&S ZNA, the supported option path is ZNA-K2 for TDR plus ZNA-K20 for extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram.[15]  
【推論】If the goal is only IL/TDR in PCB or AI-server PCB mapping, the cited passages support R&S ZNA / ZNB as IL/TDR families but do not establish an eye-diagram requirement for ZNB.[28]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 已整理 R&S 2026.3.4 high-speed digital 簡報中的 material measurement、stackup selection、SI testing 與 sampling / process monitoring；本來源把部分 R&S solution 對應到特定市場分類，例如 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] 的 IL / TDR、[[R&S FSWP]] 的 jitter / phase noise / LDO NSD test、[[MXO]] 的 power rail / motor driver analysis。
